Side A · Recipe 03

Tape memory

Lo-fi arpeggio, round-robin voices

A fast arpeggio where every note is a different instrument, echoed by a worn tape machine and a grainy small room. Like a cassette of a song you half remember.

Level
Easy
Setup
10 min
Key
C major

  3. 2. Grand Canyon: a worn tape echo

What you'll hear

A quick sixteenth-note pattern. Each note comes from the next synth channel in turn, each set up differently, so one line sounds like three instruments trading notes. The echoes warble and wear out like old tape.

The trick: the PERfourMER's M2 play mode sends each new note to the next channel. The manual says it makes one sequence sound like several new ones.

1. PERfourMER: three different voices, one line

Synth channels 1, 3 and 4 on MIDI channel 1, PLAYMODE M2. Rows marked (all) are the same on the three channels: set channel 1, then match the others by eye.

  • PLAYMODEM1M2P1P2D1D2Mono 2: note 1 goes to channel 1, note 2 to channel 3, note 3 to channel 4, and around again.
  • Channel 1 WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTHollow and woody.
  • Channel 3 WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTBright.
  • Channel 4 WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTSoft, like a flute.
  • Channel 4 OCTAVE4'An octave up: a sparkle every third note. Channels 1 and 3 stay at 8'.
  • CUTOFF (all)noonHalf open.
  • Filter EG INT (all)1 o'clockA little pluck on each note.
  • ATTACK (all)minInstant.
  • DECAY (all)10 o'clockShort.
  • SUSTAIN (all)minPlucked, not held.
  • RELEASE (all)9 o'clockNo clicks.
  • PAN (all)noonIn the main left output, which feeds the pedals.

2. Grand Canyon: a worn tape echo

  • DELAY TYPETAPEAn old tape echo: repeats degrade and distort.
  • TAP DIVPress until only the eighth LED lightsEchoes on the off-beat eighths, under the sixteenths.
  • TempoTap the TAP/LOOP footswitch on each beatLocks the echoes to the OXI's tempo.
  • FEEDBACKnoonSeveral repeats, each one more worn.
  • DISTORTION (left mini knob)10 o'clockA little tape grit.
  • FLUTTER DEPTH (right mini knob)1 o'clockThe warble: notes bend slightly, like a stretched cassette.
  • DELAY LVL11 o'clockEchoes under the dry line.
  • PING PONGoffonEchoes bounce left and right.

3. NightSky: a grainy small room

  • TEXTUREsparsedensediffuseGranular: with short, staccato notes it adds a grainy texture.
  • LENGTH10 o'clockShort: a room, not a hall.
  • SIZE/PITCH11 o'clockA little smaller than the middle (clockwise makes the space bigger).
  • FILTERregenlow passA synth-style roll-off on the output.
  • HIGH CUT1 o'clockTakes the hiss off, like tape.
  • LOW CUT9 o'clockBarely.
  • SHIMMER (knob)minOff.
  • GLIMMERhighlowoffOff: keep it simple.
  • DEPTHminNo modulation: the tape already wobbles.
  • DRYnoonUnity.
  • REVERB11 o'clockA light coat.

4. The OXI One: play it

Sequencer 1 Mono on Ch 1; sequencer 2 Mono on Ch 2 for the bass.

  1. Tempo 95–110 BPM.
  2. Sequencer 1: fill all 16 steps with a pattern of 4 or 5 notes repeating (for example C, E, G, B, D). A length that isn't a multiple of 3 keeps changing which of the three voices plays which note.
  3. Short gates: hold a pad and turn knob 3 down.
  4. Sequencer 2 (the bass patch from the rig page): a low C on steps 1 and 9.

You got it right when

  • Consecutive notes come from different-sounding voices.
  • The echoes wobble slightly and get darker with each repeat.

5. The performance

  • Switch PLAYMODE between M1 and M2 while it plays: the same notes become one instrument, then three.
  • Hold the Grand Canyon's TAP/LOOP footswitch: it ramps the feedback to maximum, and ramps back to your setting when you release. A tape run-away on demand.

If it sounds wrong

  • All notes sound the same: PLAYMODE isn't M2, or channels 3 and 4 aren't on MIDI channel 1.
  • Seasick: FLUTTER DEPTH lower.
  • Echoes pile into mush: FEEDBACK lower, or DELAY LVL lower.

Sources

  • PERfourMER MKII manual: PLAYMODE M2, "the impression of (up to) four new sequences" (pp. 26–27).
  • Grand Canyon manual: TAPE (p. 18), TAP DIV (p. 12), hold TAP/LOOP to ramp feedback (p. 13).
  • NightSky manual: sparse texture (p. 5), FILTER low pass (p. 4).
  • OXI One MKII manual: steps and gates (pp. 51, 55).
